programs.title: Governing the Grid: Worker Voice in Agent-Managed Solar DAOs
outcomes: Explain how an agent-managed, human-governed DAO assigns tasks to agents and final votes to people
Identify which decisions (treasury.transfer, proposal.enact) remain reserved for humans and why
Draft a worker-informed proposal for the Proposal Forum using desert solar siting facts

sessions.activity: Read the DAO charter and map the five human-reserved actions; discuss how worker voice fits governance.final_vote
Simulate Task Router coordination for a Bhadla-style desert solar build; workers flag safety and skills gaps
Small groups draft a proposal (agent-assisted, human-decided) and run a mock final vote with secret ballot
Review sample measurable outcomes and build a tracking dashboard for training hours and skills gained

programs.data_shared: Anonymized training-hours, task-completion and skills-gap tallies from sessions, contributed to shared workforce models.
programs.consent: Opt-in participation with written notice; no personal identifiers collected; aggregated data only after group consent; withdrawal removes data at next aggregation cycle.

programs.title: Sun, Sand and Shared Decisions: A Solar DAO Civic Lab
outcomes: Locate Bhadla Solar Park in the Thar Desert and describe why desert flats suit solar
Explain 'agents operate; people govern' using the five reserved human actions
Run a classroom vote that mirrors Proposal Forum decision-making

sessions.activity: Use Evidence Monitor-style summaries to learn about desert solar parks; separate evidence from claims
Rewrite the DAO mission in student words; identify outcomes a class charter could measure
Teams draft a mock solar-desk proposal; agents (students in role) draft, all students vote
Track a two-week class outcome chart and present findings like the Progress Tracker agent

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class-level vote tallies and pre/post quiz scores only; no individual student data shared.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent signed consent required for all data sharing; lesson participation itself also requires school permission slip; students may opt out of data contribution while still attending; all data aggregated and de-identified.

programs.title: Evidence to Action: NGO Partnerships with Agent-Managed DAOs
outcomes: Assess how the Research Synthesis Lab and Proposal Forum structure supports evidence-based advocacy
Design a partnership where NGOs hold human votes while agents handle research and drafting
Define measurable outcomes an NGO could track in a desert-energy governance context

sessions.activity: Practice turning monitoring feeds into concise evidence briefs via a synthesis exercise on solar in arid regions
Draft a partnership grant proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter role modeled; humans keep enactment authority
Map a working-group structure using Collaborator Scout and Task Router roles across partner organizations
Define 3-5 measurable outcomes and a review cadence for the partnership

programs.data_shared: Anonymized outcome indicators and proposal-stage metadata (counts, timelines) contributed to shared governance models.
programs.consent: Organizational MOU plus individual opt-in; no beneficiary personal data collected; results shared only in aggregate; any partner may exit and purge contributions.

programs.title: Charter to Impact: Building a Human-Governed Solar DAO Program
outcomes: Translate the charter mission into a program plan with measurable outcomes
Assign agent roles vs human-reserved actions in a nonprofit governance blueprint
Prototype a decision cycle from drafting to human final vote

sessions.activity: Workshop a charter-aligned mission and contribution model for a desert-solar public-good program
Run a full decision cycle: agent-drafted proposal, debate, recorded human final vote (never agent-enacted)
Build a task-routing board linking six agent roles to nonprofit staff and volunteers
Set baselines and a review ritual tracking progress against the charter's measurable outcomes
Steward a living evidence log; practice summarizing findings for board and community audiences

programs.data_shared: Anonymized program-outcome metrics and governance-cycle timing data for shared nonprofit benchmarking models.
programs.consent: Board-approved data policy; individual opt-in for any participant data; strictly aggregated outputs; clear withdrawal path and periodic consent renewal.
